OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) JOIN g_n_profile_d2a57d n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND CASE WHEN n1.root_id = ?
